verdict: Kit: Choose Kit when creator/newsletter email with landing pages and monetization is the primary job (including ConvertKit migrations). Scores use the email-marketing editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Free Newsletter plan plus clear Creator/Pro ladder
Unlimited landing pages/forms across researched plans
weaknesses: Free automation limits push serious journeys to Creator
Not a sales CRM of record
bestFor: Creators and newsletter publishers monetizing an audience
Writers/coaches needing landing pages, forms, and visual automations
Teams migrating from ConvertKit-era workflows under the Kit brand
notIdealFor: Ecommerce brands needing catalog-aware SMS attribution
B2B teams needing CRM-pipeline automation as the primary job
Buyers who only want the cheapest send-based SMB ESP
tradeoffs: Forever-free / trial entry vs paid feature unlocks
Core ESP breadth vs adjacent deliverability/verification specialization
recommendation: Choose Kit when creator/newsletter email with landing pages and monetization is the primary job (including ConvertKit migrations). Compare Flodesk for design-led creator email, Beehiiv for newsletter growth platforms, MailerLite for simpler free-tier SMB email, and Omnisend/Klaviyo for ecommerce.
